functions.desc:
Once you have collected information about the trip, call this function once for each day of the trip, starting on day 1.
If a field does not apply for a given day, use "-" to indicate this.
You MUST call this function to save the plan for each query.

json_schema.description:
Once you have collected information about the trip, call this function once for each day of the trip, starting on day 1.
If a field does not apply for a given day, use "-" to indicate this.
You MUST call this function to save the plan for each query.

current_city.description: The city for this day. If the plan is to travel between two cities, indicate it as "from A to B" (e.g. "from Ithaca to Charlotte").

transportation.description: e.g. "Flight Number: F3633413, from Ithaca to Charlotte, Departure Time: 05:38, Arrival Time: 07:46"

breakfast.description: The name of a restaurant in the city, e.g. "Nagaland's Kitchen, Charlotte"

attraction.description: Use a ";" to separate different attractions, with each attraction formatted as "Name, City". e.g. "The Charlotte Museum of History, Charlotte;"

accommodation.description: e.g. "Affordable Spacious Refurbished Room in Bushwick!, Charlotte"

json_schema.title: submit_day_plan

msg.content: Could you assist in creating a travel plan for one person departing from Seattle and visiting San Francisco for 3 days, from March 21st to March 23rd, 2022? The new budget is $900.
Could you assist in creating a travel plan for one person departing from Seattle and visiting San Francisco for 3 days, from March 21st to March 23rd, 2022? The new budget is $900.

content.content:
We need to create travel plan for one person departing Seattle, visiting San Francisco for 3 days, March 21-23 2022. Budget $900. Need to produce plan and save using submit_day_plan for each day (3 calls). Include city for each day, transportation, breakfast, attraction, lunch, dinner, accommodation. Since they depart Seattle, day 1 March 21: travel from Seattle to San Francisco (maybe flight or train). Provide transportation details. Then day 1 activities in San Francisco. Also accommodation for each night (maybe same hotel). Need to fit budget $900: include approximate costs? Not required to list costs, just plan. Provide restaurants etc. Must not ask follow-up.

We'll assume flight early morning, arrival midday. Breakfast maybe in Seattle before travel. Lunch in SF, dinner. Accommodation: budget hotel like "Hotel Whitcomb, San Francisco". Provide attractions: Golden Gate Bridge, Fisherman's Wharf, Alcatraz, etc. Use semicolons.

We need to call submit_day_plan for each day. Provide fields: day, current_city, transportation, breakfast, attraction, lunch, dinner, accommodation.

Day 1: from Seattle to San Francisco. current_city "from Seattle to San Francisco". transportation: "Flight AA1234, from Seattle (SEA) to San Francisco (SFO), Departure 07:00, Arrival 09:30". breakfast: maybe "Portage Bay Cafe, Seattle". attraction: list multiple attractions? Since arrival midday, maybe "Pier 39, San Francisco; Fisherman's Wharf, San Francisco". lunch: "Boudin Bakery Café, San Francisco". dinner: "Sotto Mare, San Francisco". accommodation: "Hotel Whitcomb, San Francisco".

Day 2: March 22 full day SF. current_city "San Francisco". transportation: maybe "Public transit day pass". breakfast: "Mama's on Washington Square". attraction: "Golden Gate Bridge, San Francisco; Golden Gate Park, San Francisco; de Young Museum, San Francisco". lunch: "The Picnic at Golden Gate Park (food trucks)". dinner: "Tony's Pizza Napoletana, San Francisco". accommodation same.

Day 3: March 23 last day. current_city "San Francisco". transportation: maybe "Flight SF to Seattle". breakfast: "Blue Bottle Coffee, San Francisco". attraction: "Alcatraz Island Tour, San Francisco". lunch: "Swan Oyster Depot". dinner: maybe "Return flight, dinner on plane"? Could set dinner as "-". accommodation: "-". Since departure.

Make sure to call function three times.

  "lunch": "Boudin Bakery Café, San Francisco",

}
